title: Coral Casino UK Bonus Program: Reward for New and Regular Customers

content.text: Coral Casino offers quite an interesting and diverse bonus program. Some new users may be confused by the external design of the site. The interface does look a bit outdated and does not correspond to current trends. However, behind this interface there is a large selection of modern games, as well as excellent bonus offers.
Newcomers can expect a welcome bonus, and regular and active players will be able to activate various rewards, take part in promotions and tournaments with large prize pools.

New customers can receive a starting reward of £30. The terms of the promotion for registered customers are as simple as possible. You need to create an account, make any deposit and place bets on slots, games with live dealers for £10. Immediately after this, a welcome bonus will be credited to your balance.

It is important to note that the promotion does not include all blackjack games, as well as some deposit methods, including PayPal, Neteller, Paysafecard and prepaid cards. Keep this in mind so you don't miss out on your welcome bonus.

This is a special bonus program that allows active players to collect special Coins when participating in selected casino promotions. Once you have collected the required number of coins, you can exchange them and use them to activate prizes and bonuses.
The game Coral Coins does not have a direct monetary equivalent. That is, you cannot get cash with them.

You collect coins during the month. Their validity period is 7 days from the beginning of each new month. The terms and conditions of Coral Casino describe in detail which games are awarded coins and in what quantities. Knowing these rules, you can quickly and easily collect the maximum number of game coins.

Prize Grabber is a daily promotion that is held on the Coral Casino website. Players can win free spins, extra Coral Coins, and cash prizes worth up to £100. The maximum reward for participating in the Golden Prize Grabber is up to £500.
According to the terms of the promotion, each user can take part in the draw once a day. If you get free spins, they are credited within 48 hours and must be used within 7 days.
The uniqueness of the Prize Grabber promotion is that you can get instant rewards and accumulate various bonuses and game Coral Coins.

Casino Tournaments from Coral are a great opportunity to compete in various popular slots, bingo, slingo, and live dealer games. Every day, there are qualifying rounds that allow you to get into the main tournament grid and fight for the main prize.
The rewards are varied and can be up to £500, up to 100 free spins, and a lot of Coral Coins.
Confirmation of participation is required to participate in the tournament. Please note that most tournaments have restrictions on the maximum bet amounts.

Smart Rewards is a bonus program that is designed to motivate casino players to play more often. Here you can complete daily tasks and missions. When you complete them, you will receive various types of rewards: free spins, bonuses for games with live dealers, bingo tickets, etc.

In addition, as part of Smart Rewards, every month Coral Casino raffles off a cash prize of up to £25,000. Players who complete tasks and missions daily can become participants. Such a bonus raffle scheme is aimed at ensuring that players do not just place bets, but are active, regularly visit the site and plan their gaming activity.
This is a joint promotion by Coral Casino and provider Pragmatic Play. Participants in special games can compete for a prize pool of up to £350,000 every week.

Only selected games participate in the promotion, which also raffle off free spins, instant bonuses and bet multipliers. The promotion requires confirmation of participation. Please note that the raffles are held for a limited time and only in a certain list of games.

The Coral Casino website and apps regularly host various promotions, raffles and tournaments. This is a great opportunity to improve and extend the gaming experience, earn additional coins, free spins and cash.
The bonus program from Coral Casino makes games on this service more exciting and encourages you to come back here again and again.
